title: SLO reconciliation: token-aware weighting and fallback priority ledger
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Define a reconciled SLO/SLI ledger and prioritization algorithm that accounts for token- and request-size weighting, per-model quality anchors, and a deterministic regional fallback ordering. Deliver a policy doc + operational ledger format used by routing and the circuit-breaker service. Motivation: existing SLI policies diverge across teams (latency vs quality vs cost) and regional failover ordering is ad-hoc. This ticket produces the canonical reconciliation algorithm, example ledgers for 3 representative routes (chat-short, chat-long, embedding-bulk), and integration points for runtime and Console dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SLI definitions for 3 route archetypes (chat-short, chat-long, embeddings-bulk) documented and reviewed
Reconciliation algorithm described with pseudocode and examples; accepts per-model quality anchor and outputs per-route weighted SLO targets
Fallback priority ledger format (JSON schema) defined and validated against sample data; includes region score, model-variant preference, and cost multiplier
Circuit-breaker thresholds and load-shedding triggers derived from reconciled SLOs and validated in staging with synthetic traffic
Instrumentation hooks added to runtime to expose per-request weight and SLI attribution; Console dashboard shows expected vs actual burn rates
Handbook entry and runbook steps for emergency overrides + rollback published in Confluence
End-to-end test: simulated regional outage shows deterministic failover order and preserves declared SLOs for P0 routes within tolerance
sli_definitions: Chat-short latency SLI: p95 end-to-end server time under 120ms excluding initial tokenization; measurement window 5m rolling
Chat-long quality SLI: ngram-based similarity to reference promptset >= 0.78 on sampled 1% production traces; quality measured every 1h with stratified sampling by token-length
Embeddings-bulk throughput SLI: tokens-per-second per-allocated-GPU >= 3500 measured per minute; drop if external queueing > 5s
Token-aware weighting: each request contributes weight = sqrt(token_count) normalized by route median; reconciliation uses weighted sums when computing burn
SLI attribution: include model_variant_tag, region, and route-label on each metric point for downstream aggregation
error_budget_policy: Error budget accounting uses 28-day sliding window for non-critical routes and 7-day window for P0 routes
Burn rate alarms: >3x baseline for 1h triggers staged throttling; >5x for 10m triggers immediate circuit-breaker for lower-priority variants
Credit transfers: short-lived emergency borrowing between sibling routes permitted only with approval from SRE owner and recorded in the ledger
Debt repayment: borrowed budget must be repaid within 14 days or triggers automatic constraint on autoscaler for borrower route
failover_and_cb_policy: Fallback ledger entries include: region_id, region_score (higher is preferred), available_capacity_score, last_known_latency_adjustment, cost_multiplier, model_variant_weights
Region scoring priority: availability SLO compliance > network RTT penalty > capacity headroom > cost multiplier; arbitrary ties broken by lexicographic region_id
Circuit-breaker escalation: soft-open when regional burn_rate > 2x for 30m (reduce traffic to 50% to that region), hard-open when burn_rate > 4x for 5m (evacuate traffic for lower-priority routes)

Load-shedding strategy: token-aware admission-control (reject or queue requests based on predicted token-cost and current global weighted burn); small requests prioritized if route_quality_anchor indicates sensitivity
Model-variant preemption: pinned variants preserved until their error budget is exhausted; preemption uses variant_weight from ledger to select fallbacks
rollout_plan: Write ledger schema and reconciliation service spec (week 1)
Staging integration with runtime routing + CB service; run controlled chaos (week 3)
Gradual canary: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% for P1 routes; P0 routes require SRE-led gate and manual sign-off
Post-rollout: 2-week shadow monitoring and one-week rollback window; capture real burn-rate vs predicted
metrics_and_dashboards: New dashboard: 'SLO Reconciliation - Live Ledger' showing reconciled target SLOs, current realized SLIs, and regional burn rates
Alert: Reconciler drift > 5% for P0 routes for 30m -> page oncall
Console tile: per-route forecasted burn for next 24h computed from weighted historical traces
Logging: reconciliation decisions recorded with request_sample_ids for replay (retention 90d)
